decisions.decision: GeoCeDG layer domain is the bounded non-negative range 0..99 for the first extension; L_MAX = 99 is a product/configuration limit, not a permanent CeDG restriction; Classic keeps 0..9
A is split into A-1 and A-2
forward-compatibility loss with older Classic and GeoCeDG readers is accepted and documented explicitly: layers above 9 may be clamped to 9 and lost when saved by those readers
workingLayer is SESSION; New starts at layer 0; initialization after Open preserves the document and does not silently modify persisted visibility state

hidden layers are conceptually DOCUMENT_PRESENTATION, document-wide, persistent and not undoable; A-1 implements the mechanism with SESSION state; A-2 adds persistence; objects on hidden layers are excluded from LaTeX; DXF policy is resolved in C
the working-layer mode is one-shot and returns to Move after a valid selection
upstream ShowLayer and HideLayer stay unchanged and keep acting on individual object visibility

(1) the working layer cannot be hidden through normal interaction; (2) selecting a currently hidden layer as working layer shows it and makes it the working layer; (3) the interaction between Open and persistent hidden layers is deferred to A-2 and resolved explicitly before A-2, without silently altering presentation on load
paste keeps the copied objects' layers and does not move them to the working layer

PRE-G9B-R6-plus-A-1.scope: operational workspace, working layer, Move-group mode, status bar, numeric Algebra View order, effective hiding in the normal views (painting and hit testing), SESSION hidden-layer state; no domain widening, no new serialization, no exporter change

PRE-G9B-R6-plus-A-2.scope: layer-domain widening to 0..99 and hidden-layer persistence, with their serialization and compatibility impact
PRE-G9B-R6-plus-A-2.entryCondition: AQ-L7 (3) resolved explicitly by the author
